question.problem: Toria's friend holds a barrel of $150$ marbles in front of her, each with a slightly different size or color.  If she reaches in and grabs five of them, how many different groups of five marbles can Toria select?
question.worked_solution:
In general, the number of combinations of $n$ objects taken $r$ at a time is given by the formula

$$
{}_{n}{C}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!\,r!}.
$$

There are $150$ marbles, so $n=150.$ We want to select $5$ of those marbles from the bag, so we have $r=5.$

Therefore, the number of different potential groups of five marbles is

$$
\begin{aligned}{}_{150}{C}_{5} & =\frac{150!}{(150-5)!\,5!} \\  & =\frac{150!}{145!5!} \\  & =\frac{150\cdot 149\cdot 148\cdot 147\cdot 146\cdot \cancel{145!}}{\cancel{145!}5!} \\  & =\frac{150\cdot 149\cdot 148\cdot 147\cdot 146}{5\cdot 4\cdot 3\cdot 2\cdot 1} \\  & =591\,600\,030.\end{aligned}
$$
